description: Source code for the ProgramTable class managing ELF program headers and segments in a custom ELF loader implementation.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Manages ELF program headers, segments, and memory mapping for ELF loading.

methods.name: ProgramTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing ProgramTable with optional memory-mapped file extension.

methods.name: LoadProgramHeader
methods.description: Loads and memory maps the ELF program header table from a file.

methods.name: LoadSegments
methods.description: Loads ELF segments into memory, handling PT_LOAD and PT_NOTE types.

methods.name: GetLoadMemorySize
methods.description: Calculates total memory size needed for loadable segments.

methods.name: GetDynamicSection
methods.description: Retrieves the dynamic section entries from program headers.

methods.name: AdjustMemoryProtectionOfReadOnlySegments
methods.description: Adjusts memory protections for read-only segments.

methods.name: ReserveLoadMemory
methods.description: Reserves address space for loading segments.

methods.name: PublishEvergreenInfo
methods.description: Publishes metadata about the loaded ELF for debugging or tracking.

methods.name: GetBaseMemoryAddress
methods.description: Returns the base address of the loaded ELF in memory.
